name: voice-mouth
goal: T22 in-game voice and the talking cat (CatTalk): a real client talks through the real voice path (push to talk forced, server routing, unreliable RPC, decoding, levelling, FMOD playback) with a synthetic voice instead of Steam's microphone (-autoplay-voice-probe client). On the host, the client's cat must open its black mouth while the voice plays: voice.probe events with shown=True and open > 0 for the client's seat, GameLog avatar.talk.open. Checked in the lobby too (-autoplay-lobby-hold 25: the playtest of 2026-11-20 only spoke there): voice-close-* close-ups render the speaker's face while the mouth is open. The speaker's OWN cat opens its mouth on his own screen too (voice.probe shown=True on the client: playtest 2026-11-20, Flox talked during an emote and saw his cat's mouth shut).
